## finance Domain Capabilities (6 available)

### finance.fundamental
Financial statements, valuation metrics, analyst ratings, shareholder structure, SEC filings

**Parameters:**
- `type` (required): Data type. Values: `overview` (summary card: ratings + target price + income statement + key metrics, international markets), `income` (income statement, A-shares), `balance` (balance sheet, A-shares), `cashflow` (cash flow statement, A-shares), `indicator` (financial indicators: ROE/gross margin etc., A-shares), `holder` (top 10 shareholders, A-shares)
- `symbol` (required): International market ticker, used when type=overview. E.g., `AAPL`. When empty, parsed from query
- `cn_code` (required): A-share ticker, **required** when type=income/balance/cashflow/indicator/holder. E.g., `600519.SH`
- `period`: Used only when type=holder, controls shareholder data time range. Default `1y`

### finance.news
Global financial news, company announcements, broker research summaries

**Parameters:**
- `period`: Query time range. type=flash/announcement defaults to `1d` (current day). Valid values same as quote
- `symbol`: International market ticker, used only when type=stock. E.g., `AAPL`. When empty, parsed from query
- `type` (required): News type. Values: `general` (global English financial news), `stock` (international single-stock news), `flash` (Chinese financial headlines), `announcement` (A-share listed company announcements)
- `cn_code`: A-share ticker, used only when type=announcement. E.g., `600519.SH`. When empty, returns market-wide announcements
- `news_src`: Chinese flash news source, used only when type=flash. Default `sina`. Values: `sina` (Sina Finance), `wallstreetcn` (Wallstreetcn), `10jqka` (Tonghuashun), `eastmoney` (East Money), `cls` (Cailian Press), `yicai` (Yicai), `yuncaijing` (Cloud Finance), `fenghuang` (Phoenix Finance), `jinrongjie` (Financial Street)

### finance.screen
Screen stocks by market cap, PE, dividend yield, sector, country (international markets only)

**Parameters:**
- `type` (required): Screen type. Values: `stock` (screen stocks by sector/country), `etf` (search ETFs by name, query used as filter)
- `sector`: GICS sector, used only when type=stock. Values: `Technology`, `Healthcare`, `Financial Services`, `Consumer Cyclical`, `Consumer Defensive`, `Industrials`, `Energy`, `Basic Materials`, `Communication Services`, `Real Estate`, `Utilities`
- `country`: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, used only when type=stock. E.g., `US`, `JP`, `GB`, `DE`, `CN`, `HK`. Note: filters by company registration country, not exchange country

### finance.calendar
Earnings dates, guidance, economic data releases, IPO schedules

**Parameters:**
- `type` (required): Calendar type. Values: `earnings` (earnings release schedule), `dividends` (dividend calendar), `ipos` (IPO schedule), `economic` (economic data release calendar)
- `period`: Forward-looking time range. Default `7d`. Valid values same as quote
- `symbol`: Stock ticker, used only when type=dividends. E.g., `AAPL`. When empty, returns market-wide schedule

### finance.macro
Macroeconomic indicators: GDP, CPI, PMI, interest rates (Shibor/LPR/Fed Funds), money supply, social financing

**Parameters:**
- `type` (required): Indicator type. Values: `gdp` (China & US GDP), `cpi` (China & US CPI), `fed_funds` (Federal Funds Rate), `treasury` (US Treasury yield curve 1M~30Y), `unemployment` (US unemployment rate), `nonfarm` (US nonfarm payrolls), `shibor` (China interbank rates), `lpr` (China LPR loan rates), `money_supply` (China M0/M1/M2), `social_finance` (China aggregate social financing)
- `period`: Data time range. Default varies by type: gdp defaults to `2y`, cpi/lpr/money_supply/social_finance defaults to `1y`, shibor defaults to `30d`, US indicators truncated by maxResults. Valid values same as quote

### finance.quote
Real-time and historical quotes for stocks, forex, crypto, commodities, indices, ETFs, futures

**Parameters:**
- `type` (required): Asset type. Values: `stock` (global stocks + A-shares), `forex` (foreign exchange), `crypto` (cryptocurrency), `commodity` (commodities), `index` (Chinese indices), `etf` (Chinese ETFs)
- `symbol`: International market symbol. type=stock: e.g., `AAPL`; type=forex: e.g., `EURUSD` (6-char pair); type=crypto: e.g., `BTCUSD` (required); type=commodity: e.g., `CLUSD` (empty returns market snapshot)
- `cn_code`: Chinese market symbol. type=stock: e.g., `000001.SZ`, `600519.SH`; type=index: e.g., `399300.SZ`; type=etf: e.g., `510300.SH`; type=forex: e.g., `USDCNH.FXCM`
- `period`: Historical data time range. Values: `7d`/`14d`/`30d`/`90d`/`180d`/`1y`/`5y` or custom `{N}d`. International markets default `7d`, Chinese markets default `30d`
